title: Early Signs of Puberty: Confident Dialogue about the Changing Body
summary: Signs of puberty may begin at this age, and your child needs to hear about them from you first—not from peers or the internet. Speak with calmness and clarity appropriate for his age about the coming physical changes, reassuring him that these are natural and that you are his trusted source. Early dialogue protects him from misinformation and from shame.
try_this: This week: Open a short, reassuring conversation about one physical change, and let your child know he can always ask you.
reflection_prompts: Have you spoken with your child about puberty yet?
Does he feel he can ask you?
